images.title: Five counters fuse into one
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the base grouping builder in base 5: five counters in the 1 bin fuse into one counter in the 5 bin.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three landmark bins side by side with a curved arrow from the right bin to the middle bin.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: the label base 5. Below it, three open rectangular bins in a row, labelled under them, left to right: 25, 5, 1. The 25 bin is empty. The 1 bin holds exactly 5 pale grey (#6B7280) ghost counters ringed by one amber (#E69F00) outline. One curved amber arrow goes from the 1 bin to the 5 bin, labelled 5 make 1. The 5 bin holds exactly 1 solid teal (#0072B2) counter. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In base 5, every 5 of one landmark trade for 1 of the next.
